title: Facepulls - Nucleus overload
summary: Short clip of face pulls used as a nucleus overload option. Per the description, face pulls isolate the rear delts, are easy on the joints, allow intensity manipulation and are healthy for the shoulders. The transcript is background audio unrelated to the video.

claims.claim: Face pulls are an excellent nucleus overload option: they isolate the rear delts, are not taxing on the joints, are friendly to intensity manipulation and are healthy for the shoulders.
